_why: 2026-10-03. Only `run` had a help arm, so `<verb> --help` handed `--help` to the verb as its first argument, and the verbs whose first positional is free-form ACTED on it: `worktree-comment --help` ran `orca worktree set --worktree active --comment --help`, overwriting the active worktree's comment. The dispatcher now answers -h/--help for every listed verb before any verb runs. Each row removes one half of that.

mutations.name: help-reaches-the-verb-again
mutations._mechanism: The guard's flag pattern never matches, so `--help` falls through to the verb as its argument and `worktree-comment` clobbers the active comment again.

mutations.name: a-verb-drops-out-of-the-list
mutations._mechanism: A verb missing from `_HMAD_VERBS` bypasses the guard while main still routes it, which is how a newly added verb would reopen the defect.
